cases.subjects: Thirteen accused in Papla escape case
cases.evidence_paraphrase: TOI describes an underwear street procession and attributes a crime-recreation explanation directly to Bhiwadi SP. The two later reports concern the same parade, not new events.

cases.subjects: Four accused in vendor extortion/assault case
cases.evidence_paraphrase: Four accused were paraded to a vendor during spot verification and made apologies. The SP also framed the procession as reassuring vendors. No underwear or nakedness is established by the text.

cases.evidence_paraphrase: A compensation dispute report says police firing killed Mohan Singh during a clash. The government account alleged the crowd attempted to take police firearms; whether Singh belonged to that crowd was disputed. This is a group-claim crowd-control shooting,not an accused custody reconstruction.

cases.context_evidence_paraphrase: Source describes a Holi clash between two groups in Rameshwar Malia Lane; police made arrests and a crowd allegedly attacked them. It does not describe a jute-mill worker protest or Maoist insurgency.

cases.evidence_paraphrase: A detained domestic-violence suspect allegedly took a constable revolver and killed a homeguard;one neighbour was wounded. Locals restrained and beat the suspect before reinforcements disarmed him. He was charged with murder;the report does not describe police shooting him.
cases.notes: Essential negative comparator: firearm taking does not imply encounter killing.
cases.context_evidence_paraphrase: Officers responding to a domestic-violence complaint attempted to escort the suspect to the police station.

cases.evidence_paraphrase: Article describes several attacks on BSF personnel. At Narayanganj a group allegedly tried to take a jawan gun. A later paragraph reports two Bangladesh nationals killed in self-defence,but does not unambiguously join those deaths to that precise outpost episode.
cases.notes: Do not collapse multiple attacks into one confirmed2-death weapon-taking event. Central force,not state police.
cases.context_evidence_paraphrase: BSF account concerns groups crossing/attacking at India-Bangladesh border outposts; not Maoist insurgency in the report.

cases.subjects: Four men killed in CISF firing;separate fifth poll-violence death
cases.evidence_paraphrase: CISF and officials attributed firing at a polling-site crowd to attempted weapon taking and self-defence. A detailed followup separates four men killed by the CISF firing from another political-violence death;reports conflict over whether state police also fired.
